name: Being Modest
overview: Scripture calls believers to honor God through modesty by rejecting practices that defile the body or confuse God’s design, such as marking the flesh or wearing garments of the opposite sex, which are labeled abominations by the Lord. Walking in the Spirit helps believers resist fleshly desires, promoting holiness in conduct. Moreover, James reminds us that knowing what is right and failing to do it is sin, underscoring the responsibility to live modestly and obediently before God.
